_comment: V3 海洋未來式: 14個鏡頭(S01~S14)，含精準尾幀與電影級動態運鏡
title: 海洋未來式 第4集：藍碳救星與未來超市

h3.style: a vibrant 2D cel-shaded animated feature film, clean bold line art, deep ocean cyan and warm gallery spotlight illumination, rich harmonious colors, smooth cartoon toon shading
h3.setting: National Museum of Marine Science and Technology exhibition gallery with towering curved ocean projection screens and high-tech climate displays, as an animated cartoon set
h3.soundscape: Immersive deep sea ambient hum with gentle water resonance, museum footsteps, and crisp electronic data pulses.
h3.camera: Cinematic camera movement with smooth tracking, push-in, arc orbiting, and dynamic focal depth.
constraints: Maintain the exact cartoon animation style, clean bold outlines, and character proportions of <Picture 1> in every single frame.
Every character keeps the exact same cartoon design, clothing colors, and robot markings as in <Picture 1> from the first frame to the last frame.
Keep all museum exhibition screens, glass pedestals, and climate graphics solid, stable, and consistent with <Picture 1>.
Keep all character limbs, hands, glasses, antennas, and facial features clean and well-formed.

huang.name: 黃老師
huang.look: Teacher Huang, a cartoon Taiwanese male museum volunteer teacher with short grey-black hair, round black-rimmed glasses, a warm friendly smile, a burgundy volunteer vest over a white short-sleeve shirt, dark prayer beads on his left wrist, and black trousers
huang.h3_voice: a warm, expressive middle-aged Taiwanese male teacher voice, clear and lively, natural Taiwanese Mandarin

xiaoji.name: 小吉
xiaoji.look: Xiaoji (GiGi), a cartoon robot with a smooth round golden-yellow helmet with Puti-AI text on the forehead, large oval glowing cyan visor eyes on a dark screen face, circular cyan glowing ear discs, chunky golden-yellow armor, a small chest screen displaying GiGi, dark-grey mechanical joints, and a small backpack with a glowing cyan energy cell
xiaoji.h3_voice: a bright, energetic young boy-robot voice, heroic and highly expressive, with a faint metallic ring, natural Taiwanese Mandarin

shots.camera: Slow sweeping panoramic pan across an underwater kelp forest diorama.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji gazes in awe through a massive panoramic floor-to-ceiling glass wall at towering emerald-green kelp forests and lush seagrass meadows swaying gently in artificial sea currents.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Wide panoramic shot, 2D anime style. Xiaoji standing in front of a colossal glass aquarium showing a magnificent underwater kelp forest and seagrass meadow with sun rays filtering down, 16:9.

line.text: 哇！這片海底大森林好漂亮！比陸地上的神木還要壯觀耶！

shots.camera: Medium tracking shot beside Teacher Huang.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang walks in gracefully, pointing up toward floating carbon-dioxide molecular bubbles being captured by the kelp leaves on the screen.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Medium shot, 2D anime style. Teacher Huang in burgundy vest pointing up at glowing holographic CO2 bubbles being absorbed by cartoon kelp plants, 16:9.

line.text: 這就是地球最強大的固碳高手——藍碳！紅樹林、海草床跟海藻森林！

shots.camera: Tight close-up with data graphics reflecting in visor.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji blinks his cyan visor as mathematical carbon sequestration comparison formulas flash rapidly across his eye screen.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Close-up shot, 2D anime style. Xiaoji calculating data, glowing green mathematical numbers and tree vs kelp icons reflected on his visor, 16:9.

line.text: 藍碳？牠們吸碳的速度，比陸地上的森林還要厲害嗎？

shots.camera: Eye-level medium shot with dynamic infographic backdrops.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang nods enthusiastically, hands opening wide as an infographic behind him shows coastal wetlands storing carbon for thousands of years in sediment.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Medium shot, 2D anime style. Teacher Huang explaining with open hands in front of an animated sediment layer diagram demonstrating millennial carbon storage, 16:9.

line.text: 何止厲害！紅樹林吸碳固碳的速度，可是熱帶雨林的四到十倍呢！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji salutes toward the giant kelp forest, his golden armor catching the vivid green light.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Low-angle close-up, 2D anime style. Xiaoji rendering a respectful salute to the underwater kelp forest, green light reflections, bright comic expression, 16:9.

line.text: 失敬失敬！原來海草才是真正的地球救火隊長！

shots.camera: Tracking dolly guiding viewers toward an interactive supermarket entrance.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang turns around with a welcoming gesture, guiding Xiaoji into an open, brightly lit marketplace called 'Ocean Future Market'.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Medium wide shot, 2D anime style. Teacher Huang gesturing warmly towards a bustling, sleek Japanese-style zero-waste eco-supermarket exhibit, 16:9.

line.text: 更厲害的在後面！來看看未來的低碳超市，我們日常該怎麼買！

shots.camera: Eye-level medium shot pushing along produce shelves.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji pushes a lightweight bamboo shopping cart, inspecting naked zero-packaging fresh vegetables and seaweed chips with curious eyes.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Medium shot, 2D anime style. Xiaoji pushing a modern bamboo shopping cart past wooden shelves filled with plastic-free bulk produce and glass jars, 16:9.

line.text: 哇！架子上全都沒有塑膠袋包裝耶！連標籤都是電子水墨紙！

shots.camera: Two-shot medium close-up over shopping cart.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang picks up a twine-tied package of organic Taiwanese kelp, showing Xiaoji the zero-carbon certification logo stamped on the brown paper wrapping.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Medium two-shot, 2D anime style. Teacher Huang showing Xiaoji an organic twine-tied kelp package with a green low-carbon stamp in the supermarket exhibit, 16:9.

line.text: 在地海藻、裸買裸賣、自備提袋，每一次消費都是在為地球的未來投票！

shots.camera: High-angle medium shot directly over the bamboo shopping cart.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1> and finishing at <Picture 2>, the camera tilts slightly downward as Xiaoji steadily lowers both arms, placing the twine-tied kelp package smoothly into the bamboo basket beside fresh vegetables.
shots.first_frame_prompt: High-angle medium shot, 2D anime style. Xiaoji holding a twine-tied paper kelp package with both hands at chest level directly above a bamboo shopping cart basket, 16:9.
shots.last_frame_prompt: Maintain exact same high-angle angle and Xiaoji character from <Picture 1>. Xiaoji does NOT turn around. Xiaoji has gently lowered both hands into the basket, resting the kelp package securely next to fresh produce, 16:9.

line.text: 放進我的菜籃！今天晚餐就吃低碳海帶豆腐味噌湯！

shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder medium shot facing the electronic checkout counter.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang scans a virtual carbon credit card at the checkout terminal, green digital leaves floating up on the screen showing negative carbon points earned.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Medium shot, 2D anime style. Teacher Huang tapping a green carbon credit card on a futuristic transparent POS terminal, digital green leaves floating upward, 16:9.

line.text: 嗶一聲！只要選擇低碳認證產品，你就能直接賺取海洋保育點數！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji taps his golden chest plate proudly as his energy gauge fills up with a sparkling green eco-charge.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Low-angle close-up, 2D anime style. Xiaoji glowing with pride, green eco-energy bar flashing full on his chest display, bright museum lighting, 16:9.

line.text: 太讚了！原來愛地球不只不麻煩，還能變得這麼時尚又有趣！

shots.camera: Wide panoramic two-shot with golden sunset lighting.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang and Xiaoji walk toward the expansive glass exit gallery, golden sunset rays reflecting off the calm ocean surface visible outside.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Wide panoramic shot, 2D anime style. Teacher Huang and Xiaoji walking side-by-side toward a grand glass observation hall overlooking the sunset over Keelung bay, 16:9.

line.text: 海洋的未來不是預言，而是我們每一個人的選擇。小吉，準備好出發了嗎？

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji turns to the camera, giving a crisp high-energy thumbs-up, eyes shining with warmth and determination.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Medium front-facing hero shot, 2D anime style. Xiaoji giving an enthusiastic thumbs-up to the viewer with glowing cyan eyes, golden armor catching golden hour sunlight, 16:9.

line.text: 準備好了！大家跟著我和黃老師，一起守護我們的海洋未來式！

shots.camera: Dolly out and spiral pedestal up into grand aerial perspective.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the camera smoothly dollies backward while spiraling upward in an elegant ascending crane move. Teacher Huang and Xiaoji stand side-by-side at the observation railing waving toward the horizon, while the entire futuristic ocean ecological dome and sparkling blue sea expand grandly beneath them.
shots.first_frame_prompt: Wide cinematic shot, 2D anime animation style. Teacher Huang and Xiaoji standing together at a panoramic observation deck, waving outward towards an expansive eco-harbor with solar boats and offshore wind turbines under magnificent sunset skies, 16:9 widescreen.

line.text: 海科館海洋未來式特展，期待與你一起創造藍色奇蹟！
